releaseNotes: Unified Download Progress Modal: Centralized all download flows (Game Folder Setup, Map Mods Download, and Launcher Updates) into a single glassmorphic modal overlay with real-time status and animated progress tracking
Standardized Notification Host: Consolidated all floating toasts and alerts into a uniform top-center container with consistent dark glass styling, glow borders, and slide animations
Streamlined Sidebar Navigation: Reordered navigation into a clean 6-item workflow (Select Game Directory, Game Folder Download, Map Mods Download, About Launcher, Log Out, Exit)
Direct Map Mods Deployment: Map mods (.scs) now download directly to Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\mod with automatic OneDrive fallback and directory creation
Steam Integration & Status Detection: Live status indicator chip in header showing Steam Running/Offline status with one-click Steam launch
Silent Automated Game Directory Setup: Downloads Euro Truck Simulator 2.zip from Cloudflare R2 with automatic timestamped backup and zero prompt interruptions
Strict .scs Mod Update Scanner: Exclusively checks .scs files for mod updates, completely excluding .zip archives and profile packages from background scans and update popups
Polished Top-Right Window Controls: Aligned Steam indicator chip height, radius, and vertical alignment with circular window action buttons
Process Safety & Stability: Process lock validation, tray close minimization, and explicit exit force-kill protection
